title: Pico Boulevard paving and safety improvements
description:
The city of Santa Monica is making progress on the East Pico safety Project, improving one of the city’s busiest corridors along East Pico Boulevard from 26th St. to Centinela Ave.

The project is scheduled to wrap up this week before Thanksgiving. Crews are adding finishing touches, reconstructing pavement, upgrading  bus pads and painting new striping and installing signage and markings, to give Pico a smoother, safer and more vibrant look.

This work aligns with the city’s Realignment Plan and its ongoing commitment to safe neighborhoods and clean streets across Santa Monica.
